$comment: (TJ CG) The binary-compatibility baselines: main's latest three releases (rolled), the anchors (GI: one older release per API minor family, never rolled, so a family stays covered once the three roll past it) and the consumer jars, read by tools/gate6a.mjs apijars (the unchanged apitest jars in game), tools/api-compat.mjs --baselines (their references, the newest mod jar's whole surface, each consumer's references) and rolled by tools/release-version.mjs at every release. Each release's files live in <main checkout>/artifacts/api-baselines/<dir>/ (untracked), built from its tag by `node tools/api-baselines-build.mjs build <tag>`; a consumer's by `node tools/api-baselines-build.mjs steward`. docs/GATES.md "API compatibility baselines".
